eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hello, I'd like the earliest gynaecology check-up. It's for me.
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Jordi Puig Vilar born second of February 1969
Sin huecos en ginecología · frenados por regla: Dra. Isabel Morán (el seguro no cubre esa especialidad)
Thank you, Jordi, I have your record here. Your Adeslas plan doesn't cover gynaecology. Do you have any other insurance I could use?
Oh yes, I also have Sanitas.
Prueba con el segundo seguro de la ficha (Sanitas)
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 9:00 con la Dra. Isabel Morán en Arenal Centro
